mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as fixed income becomes less attractive relative to equities.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals economic deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated corporate earnings contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or the signal fails to outperform market returns in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1 YoY > 1.5%) and housing starts strength (HOUST YoY > 2.0%) indicate robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate confidence and consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > 1.5% and HOUST YoY growth > 2.0%
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when either GDPC1 or HOUST growth is below threshold, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation cooling (CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and monthly decline) signals potential Fed rate cuts, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations become more attractive relative to fixed income.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC < 0.01 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100) reflects robust manufacturing activity, correlating with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate output and profitability.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 fails to produce positive returns in > 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Robust job growth (PAYEMS > 159,000 thousand) indicates a tight labor market, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 55% of instances where PAYEMS > 159000, or Rank IC < 0.01 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High real sales (RSAFS > 730,000 million) in a late-cycle expansion regime signals sustained consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy avoids downturn.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 45% of cases meeting the trigger, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 3.0) create stable monetary conditions, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced market volatility.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative in > 55% of instances meeting the trigger, or Rank IC < 0.01 over 3-year rolling windows.
